input_text: What is the highest eligible free rate for K-12 students in the schools in Alameda County?
evidence: Eligible free rate for K-12 = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`
input_sql: SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda' ORDER BY (CAST(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (K-12)`) DESC LIMIT 1
output_sql: SELECT CAST("FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" AS FLOAT)/NULLIF(CAST("ENROLLMENT (K-12)" AS FLOAT),0) FROM FRPM WHERE "COUNTY NAME" = 'Alameda' ORDER BY CAST("FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" AS FLOAT)/NULLIF(CAST("ENROLLMENT (K-12)" AS FLOAT),0) DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

input_text: Please list the lowest three eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 in continuation schools.
evidence: Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
input_sql: SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School' AND `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3
output_sql: SELECT "FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)"/"ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" FROM FRPM WHERE "EDUCATIONAL OPTION TYPE" = 'Continuation School' AND "FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" IS NOT NULL AND "ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" IS NOT NULL AND "ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" <> 0 ORDER BY "FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)"/"ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" ASC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

input_text: Please list the zip code of all the charter schools in Fresno County Office of Education.
evidence: Charter schools refers to `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 in the table fprm
input_sql: SELECT T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
output_sql: SELECT T2.ZIP FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T1."DISTRICT NAME" = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND T1."CHARTER SCHOOL (Y/N)" = 1

input_text: What is the unabbreviated mailing street address of the school with the highest FRPM count for K-12 students?
input_sql: SELECT T2.MailStreet FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
output_sql: SELECT T2.MAILSTREET FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T1."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" = (SELECT MAX("FRPM COUNT (K-12)") FROM FRPM) AND ROWNUM = 1

input_text: Please list the phone numbers of the direct charter-funded schools that are opened after 2000/1/1.
evidence: Charter schools refers to `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 in the frpm
input_sql: SELECT T2.Phone FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'
output_sql: SELECT T2.PHONE FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T1."CHARTER FUNDING TYPE" = 'Directly funded' AND T1."CHARTER SCHOOL (Y/N)" = 1 AND T2.OPENDATE > DATE '2000-01-01'

input_text: Among the schools with the average score in Math over 560 in the SAT test, how many schools are directly charter-funded?

input_text: For the school with the highest average score in Reading in the SAT test, what is its FRPM count for students aged 5-17?

input_text: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.
evidence: Total enrollment can be represented by `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
input_sql: SELECT T2.CDSCode FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` + T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
output_sql: SELECT T2.CDSCODE FROM SCHOOLS T1 INNER JOIN FRPM T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T2."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" + T2."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" > 500

input_text: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
evidence: Excellence rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
input_sql: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3
output_sql: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" AS NUMBER) / CAST(T1."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" AS NUMBER)) FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SATSCORES T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDS WHERE CAST(T2.NUMGE1500 AS NUMBER) / CAST(T2.NUMTSTTAKR AS NUMBER) > 0.3

input_text: List the top five schools, by descending order, from the highest to the lowest, the most number of Enrollment (Ages 5-17). Please give their NCES school identification number.

input_text: How many schools in Fresno (directly funded) have number of test takers not more than 250?

input_text: List the names of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollements between K-12 and ages 5-17? Please also give the full street adress of the schools.
evidence: Diffrence in enrollement = `Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`

input_text: Give the names of the schools with the percent eligible for free meals in K-12 is more than 0.1 and test takers whose test score is greater than or equal to 1500?
evidence: Percent eligible for free meals = Free Meal Count (K-12) / Total (Enrollment (K-12)
input_sql: SELECT T2.`School Name` FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE CAST(T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1 AND T1.NumGE1500 > 0
output_sql: SELECT T2."SCHOOL NAME" FROM SATSCORES T1 INNER JOIN FRPM T2 ON T1.CDS = T2.CDSCODE WHERE (T2."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" / T2."ENROLLMENT (K-12)") > 0.1 AND T1.NUMGE1500 > 0

input_text: Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT is grater than 400, what is the funding type of these schools?

output_sql: SELECT T1.SNAME, T2."CHARTER FUNDING TYPE" FROM SATSCORES T1 INNER JOIN FRPM T2 ON T1.CDS = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T2."DISTRICT NAME" LIKE 'Riverside%' GROUP BY T1.SNAME, T2."CHARTER FUNDING TYPE" HAVING SUM(T1.AVGSCRMATH)/COUNT(T1.CDS) > 400

evidence: Full communication address should include Street, City, State and zip code if any.
input_sql: SELECT T1.`School Name`, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
output_sql: SELECT T1."SCHOOL NAME", T2.STREET, T2.CITY, T2.STATE, T2.ZIP FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T2.COUNTY = 'Monterey' AND T1."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" > 800 AND T1."SCHOOL TYPE" = 'High Schools (Public)'

input_text: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
evidence: Difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment can be computed by `Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
input_sql: SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded')
output_sql: SELECT T2.SCHOOL, T2.DOC FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T2.FUNDINGTYPE = 'Locally funded' AND (T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" - T1."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)") > (SELECT AVG(T3."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" - T3."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)") FROM FRPM T3 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T4 ON T3.CDSCODE = T4.CDSCODE WHERE T4.FUNDINGTYPE = 'Locally funded')

input_text: When did the first-through-twelfth-grade school with the largest enrollment open?
evidence: K-12 means First-through-twelfth-grade
input_sql: SELECT T2.OpenDate FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
output_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(T2.OPENDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE ORDER BY T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

input_text: Which cities have the top 5 lowest enrollment number for students in grades 1 through 12?
evidence: K-12 refers to students in grades 1 through 12.

input_text: What is the eligible free rate of the 10th and 11th schools with the highest enrolment for students in grades 1 through 12?
evidence: K-12 refers to students in grades 1 through 12; Eligible free rate for K-12 = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`
input_sql: SELECT CAST(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 9, 2
output_sql: SELECT CAST("FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" AS FLOAT) / "ENROLLMENT (K-12)" FROM FRPM ORDER BY "ENROLLMENT (K-12)" DESC OFFSET 9 ROWS FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY

input_text: What is the eligible free or reduced price meal rate for the top 5 schools in grades 1-12 with the highest free or reduced price meal count of the schools with the ownership code 66?
evidence: grades 1-12 means K-12; Eligible free or reduced price meal rate for K-12 = `FRPM Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`
input_sql: SELECT CAST(T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.SOC = 66 ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 5
output_sql: SELECT (CAST(T1."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" AS NUMBER) / T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)") FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T2."SOC" = '66' AND T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" <> 0 ORDER BY T1."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST, T1.CDSCODE ASC NULLS FIRST FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

input_text: If there are any, what are the websites address of the schools with a free meal count of 1,900-2,000 to students aged 5-17? Include the name of the school.
input_sql: SELECT T2.Website, T1.`School Name` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000 AND T2.Website IS NOT NULL
output_sql: SELECT T2.WEBSITE, T1."SCHOOL NAME" FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T1."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000 AND T2.WEBSITE IS NOT NULL

input_text: What is the free rate for students between the ages of 5 and 17 at the school run by Kacey Gibson?
evidence: Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
input_sql: SELECT CAST(T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'
output_sql: SELECT CAST(T2."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" AS NUMBER) / CAST(T2."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" AS NUMBER) FROM SCHOOLS T1 INNER JOIN FRPM T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T1.ADMFNAME1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.ADMLNAME1 = 'Gibson'

input_text: What is the administrator's email address of the chartered school with the fewest students enrolled in grades 1 through 12?
evidence: Charted school means `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 in the table frpm; Students enrolled in grades 1 through 12 refers to `Enrollment (K-12)`

output_sql: SELECT T2.ADMEMAIL1 FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T1."CHARTER SCHOOL (Y/N)" = 1 ORDER BY T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

input_text: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?
evidence: State Special Schools refers to DOC = 31; Grades 1 through 12 means K-12
input_sql: SELECT T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
output_sql: SELECT T2.SCHOOL FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T2.DOC = '31' ORDER BY T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

input_text: Which different county has the most number of closed schools? Please provide the name of each school as well as the closure date.
evidence: Closure date and closed date are synonyms; 'Closed' was mentioned in schools.StatusType.
input_sql: SELECT DISTINCT County, School, ClosedDate FROM schools WHERE County = ( SELECT County FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Closed' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(School) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND StatusType = 'Closed' AND school IS NOT NULL
output_sql: SELECT DISTINCT NVL(TRIM(COUNTY),'') COUNTY, NVL(TRIM(SCHOOL),'') SCHOOL, TO_CHAR(CLOSEDDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') CLOSEDDATE FROM SCHOOLS WHERE TRIM(COUNTY) = (SELECT county_sel FROM (SELECT TRIM(COUNTY) county_sel, COUNT(*) cnt, MIN(NVL(CDSCODE,'')) mincds FROM SCHOOLS WHERE STATUSTYPE = 'Closed' AND SCHOOL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TRIM(COUNTY) ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST, mincds ASC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AND STATUSTYPE = 'Closed' AND TRIM(SCHOOL) IS NOT NULL

input_text: What is the phone number and extension number for the school that had the 333rd highest average writing score?

output_sql: SELECT NVL(T2.PHONE,'') AS PHONE, NVL(T2.EXT,'') AS EXT FROM SATSCORES T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDS = T2.CDSCODE ORDER BY T1.AVGSCRWRITE DESC NULLS LAST, T1.CDS ASC NULLS FIRST OFFSET 332 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

input_text: What is the total number of non-chartered schools in the county of Los Angeles with a percent (%) of eligible free meals for grades 1 through 12 that is less than 0.18%?
evidence: non-chartered schools refer to schools whose Charter = 0; K-12 means grades 1 through 12; percent of eligible free rate for K-12 = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / `Enrollment (K-12)`
input_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.School) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.Charter = 0 AND CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
output_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.SCHOOL) FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T2.COUNTY = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.CHARTER = 0 AND (T1."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" * 100 / T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)") < 0.18

input_text: Which county reported the most number of school closure in the 1980s with school wonership code belonging to Youth Authority Facilities (CEA)?
evidence: Youth Authority Facilities (CEA) refers to SOC = 11; 1980s = years between 1980 and 1989
input_sql: SELECT County FROM schools WHERE strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' AND StatusType = 'Closed' AND SOC = 11 GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(School) DESC LIMIT 1
output_sql: SELECT NVL(COUNTY,'') FROM SCHOOLS WHERE TO_CHAR(CLOSEDDATE,'YYYY') BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' AND UPPER(TRIM(NVL(STATUSTYPE,''))) = 'CLOSED' AND REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(NVL(SOC,'')),'^[+-]?([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)$') AND TO_NUMBER(TRIM(NVL(SOC,''))) = 11 GROUP BY NVL(COUNTY,'') ORDER BY COUNT(SCHOOL) DESC NULLS LAST, NVL(COUNTY,'') DESC NULLS LAST, MIN(CDSCODE) ASC NULLS FIRST FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

output_sql: SELECT T1."FRPM COUNT (AGES 5-17)" FROM FRPM T1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS T2 ON T1.CDSCODE = T2.CDSCODE WHERE T2.MAILSTREET = 'PO Box 1040' AND T2.SOCTYPE = 'Youth Authority Facilities'

input_text: Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)?

input_text: For the client whose loan was approved first in 1993/7/5, what is the increase rate of his/her account balance from 1993/3/22 to 1998/12/27?
evidence: Increase rate of his/her account balance = [(balance of date A - balance of date B) / balance of Date B] * 100%

input_sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1997' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1996' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1996' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T3.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T4.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T4.gender = 'M' AND T3.type = 'OWNER'
output_sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1."DATE") = 1997 THEN T1.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1."DATE") = 1996 THEN T1.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1."DATE") = 1996 THEN T1.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) FROM LOAN T1 INNER JOIN ACCOUNT T2 ON T1.ACCOUNT_ID = T2.ACCOUNT_ID INNER JOIN DISP T3 ON T3.ACCOUNT_ID = T2.ACCOUNT_ID INNER JOIN CLIENT T4 ON T4.CLIENT_ID = T3.CLIENT_ID WHERE T4.GENDER = 'M' AND T3."TYPE" = 'OWNER'

input_text: Which top 20 driver created the shortest lap time ever record in a Formula_1 race? Please give them full names.
evidence: shortest lap time refers to MIN(time); the time format for the shortest lap time is 'MM:SS.mmm' or 'M:SS.mmm'; full name of the driver refers to forename, surname
input_sql: WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (SELECT driverId, (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds FROM lapTimes) SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.driverId FROM (SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM lap_times_in_seconds GROUP BY driverId) AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId ORDER BY T1.min_time_in_seconds ASC LIMIT 20
output_sql: WITH raw_lap AS (SELECT DRIVERID, "TIME" t, INSTR("TIME",':') pos_colon, INSTR("TIME",'.') pos_dot FROM LAPTIMES), parsed AS (SELECT DRIVERID, t, CASE WHEN pos_colon > 0 THEN CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,1,pos_colon-1)),'^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?[[:space:]]*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,1,pos_colon-1))) ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS minutes, CASE WHEN pos_dot > 0 THEN CASE WHEN pos_colon > 0 THEN CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,pos_colon+1,pos_dot-pos_colon-1)),'^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?[[:space:]]*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,pos_colon+1,pos_dot-pos_colon-1))) ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,1,pos_dot-1)),'^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?[[:space:]]*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,1,pos_dot-1))) ELSE 0 END END ELSE CASE WHEN pos_colon > 0 THEN CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,pos_colon+1)),'^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?[[:space:]]*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,pos_colon+1))) ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t),'^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?[[:space:]]*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(t)) ELSE 0 END END END AS seconds, CASE WHEN pos_dot > 0 THEN CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,pos_dot+1)),'^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(SUBSTR(t,pos_dot+1))) ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS millis FROM raw_lap), lap_times_in_seconds AS (SELECT DRIVERID, (minutes*60 + seconds + millis/1000) AS time_in_seconds FROM parsed) SELECT NVL(T2.FORENAME,'') FORENAME, NVL(T2.SURNAME,'') SURNAME, T1.DRIVERID FROM (SELECT DRIVERID, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM lap_times_in_seconds GROUP BY DRIVERID) T1 INNER JOIN DRIVERS T2 ON T1.DRIVERID = T2.DRIVERID ORDER BY T1.min_time_in_seconds ASC NULLS FIRST, T1.DRIVERID ASC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

input_text: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?

input_text: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?
